name: bff
description: nomnom client BFF powered by WunderGraph Cosmo

scripts.compose: wgc router compose --input graph.yaml --out config.json && npm run client-schema
scripts.client-schema:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('client-schema.graphql','# Generated by npm run compose from config.json: the composed client schema
# (plugin + events subgraphs) that the UI codegen and mocks read. Do not edit.

'+JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('config.json')).engineConfig.graphqlSchema.trim()+'
')"
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm test && npm run build && npm run compose && node scripts/persisted-operations.mjs --check
